Ah perfect! You're in the Strudel REPL. Let me give you some progressive deep house patterns you can build up layer by layer. Start with this foundation and add layers gradually:

```javascript
// Start with the kick foundation
$: s("bd*4").bank("tr909").gain(.8).lpf(sine.range(200,800).slow(16))

// Add the deep bass (run this after the kick is going)
$: n("a1 ~ a1 ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(60,120).slow(8)).gain(.5).room(.3)

// Add hi-hats with swing
$: s("~ [hh hh:2] ~ [hh:3 hh]").bank("tr909").gain(rand.range(.3,.6)).pan(rand.range(-.3,.3))

// Progressive bassline pattern
$: n(sequence("a1 c2 e2 g2","f1 a1 c2 e2","d1 f1 a1 c2","g1 b1 d2 f2").slow(4)).s("sawtooth").lpf(200).gain(.4)

// Atmospheric pads
$: n("am7 fmaj7 dm7 gmaj7").slow(8).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(400,1200).slow(12)).gain(.2).room(.9).delay(.3)

// Add open hats for groove
$: s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("tr909").every(4, x => x.rev()).gain(.3).delay(.08)

// Deep stabs on the off-beats
$: s("~ ~ stab ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).gain(.3).sustain(.2).every(4, x => x.early(.125))

// Lead melody (add this later for progression)
$: n("a4 c5 e5 g5 f4 a4 c5 e5").slow(8).s("triangle").lpf(sine.range(800,2400).slow(6)).gain(.25).delay(.15)
```
